meta.name: add-opencode
meta.description: Use OpenCode as an agent provider. OpenRouter, OpenAI, Google, DeepSeek, etc. via OpenCode config — not the Anthropic Agent SDK. Per group via `ncl groups config update --provider opencode`; host passes OPENCODE_* and XDG mount when spawning containers.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用 OpenCode 配置管理多种 AI 模型提供商
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在容器化环境中切换不同 AI 模型提供商
copy.tagline_en: Manage multiple AI model providers via OpenCode config
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to switch between AI model providers in containerized environments

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把 OpenCode 设为 NanoClaw 的 agent 提供方:复制 provider 文件、装依赖、重建镜像;每组可用命令切到 OpenCode,经它调用 OpenRouter、DeepSeek 等模型。
howto.when: 当你要接入 OpenCode、把某个 agent 组切换到 OpenCode,或配置 DeepSeek/OpenRouter 等模型时触发。

say.text: 帮我接入 OpenCode,把 agent 提供方换成它并重建镜像。
say.note: 会复制 provider 文件、装依赖并重建镜像。

say.text: 把 group-myapp 这个组切换到 opencode。
say.note: 会调用 ncl 命令更新配置并重启该组。

say.text: 配置 DeepSeek,设置 OPENCODE_MODEL 并注册密钥。
say.note: 会写入 .env 并通过 OneCLI 注册对应密钥。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude can set OpenCode as NanoClaw's agent provider: it copies provider files, adds imports/dependencies, rebuilds the image; each group can be switched by command to call OpenRouter/DeepSeek etc. through OpenCode.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to set up OpenCode, switch an agent group to OpenCode, or configure models like DeepSeek/OpenRouter.

say_en.text: Set up OpenCode as the agent provider and rebuild the image.
say_en.note: Copies provider files, installs deps, rebuilds image.
Runs ncl command to update config and restart the group.

say_en.text: Configure DeepSeek: set OPENCODE_MODEL and register the key.
say_en.note: Writes .env and registers key via OneCLI.
